fill.interest in joining a startup like Kerne: Yes, most of my career has been in startups. At Gramrphone, a music-tech startup, I was UX Designer and later Head of Growth and Design, owning research, product design and growth experiments end to end with a tiny team, where no job was too small. At CryptoKnowledge I built the whole product myself: brand, platform, hosting and the ad funnels. I like high autonomy and ambiguity, and as a designer who also writes front-end code I'm used to shipping rather than handing off. Kernel's problem, making messy company identity data legible to the people and agents who rely on it, is exactly the kind of complex, data-heavy design challenge I want as a founding designer.
